identity.name: PINDER-S
identity.primary_workload: All 93 PINDER-S cases with paired primary apo monomers; full PINDER-S contains 250 cases.

found_basis: Public source includes FroDock build recipe, eight-stage docking adapter, methods CLI and DockQ evaluator. Exact inputs are anonymously accessible according to brief inventory; source and mirror README fetched during intake. Published implementation defects require repair before execution.

outcome_definition.scientific: DockQ, interface RMSD (angstrom), fraction of native contacts versus native dimer; acceptable DockQ >= 0.23.
outcome_definition.ranking: Report top-ranked model separately from best DockQ among fixed candidate count; report success fraction with denominator 93, missing/failed cases explicit.

citations.title: PINDER: The Protein INteraction Dataset and Evaluation Resource
DockQ: A Quality Measure for Protein-Protein Docking Models

source_licences_and_intended_use.intended_use: Local scientific docking evaluation allowed for covered source, subject to licence conditions

source_licences_and_intended_use.item: PINDER 2024-02 index, metadata, mappings and transformed PDB inputs
source_licences_and_intended_use.reason: Repository Apache-2.0 licence does not explicitly establish coverage of externally hosted release data; no separate dataset terms established in bounded search. Original PDB structures are CC0, but derived release coverage remains ambiguous.

source_licences_and_intended_use.item: FroDock 3.12 mirror software and bin/soap.bin scoring input
source_licences_and_intended_use.reason: Original distribution/licence page returns HTTP 404. Mirror README contains citation request, no explicit permission covering software and scoring bytes. Owner authorizes local mirror use but does not establish upstream rights.

stock_cuda_image.requirements: linux/amd64; Python >=3.10, GNU compiler, FFTW single precision, OpenMPI; FroDock baseline is CPU/MPI, no CUDA requirement. Published Dockerfile uses micromamba jammy.
stock_cuda_image.reason: Stock CUDA image tag, available system libraries, CPU/RAM and build compatibility not supplied or tested. Adapter and Dockerfile have apparent source-level defects. No builds/workloads run.

size.reason: Inventory sizes exclude expanded parquet memory, generated grids, docking scratch and peak resident memory; no published representative peak memory found.

scoring_and_repeatability.rule: DockQ = (fnat + 1/(1+(iRMSD/1.5)^2) + 1/(1+(LRMSD/8.5)^2))/3; report per-model and per-case results, top rank and oracle best separately.
scoring_and_repeatability.tolerance_reason: No published numerical reproduction tolerance established; count values are references only.
scoring_and_repeatability.seed_reason: Brief requests independent seeds; no seed list published or preregistered. CPU FroDock adapter exposes no random seed. Do not simulate independent seeds by relabelling deterministic runs.
scoring_and_repeatability.selection: Fixed entire 93-case paired-apo subset; no case search or scale-doubling.
scoring_and_repeatability.material_identity: FroDock mirror and soap.bin identity with original study remain unverified; anchor agreement cannot authenticate bytes.
